## Core Enterprise Profile

Leandro Calado Ferreira has established an unmatched authority at the intersection of Tech and Law. He is an international technical author with a vast library of **116 published books** in 4 languages on Amazon KDP. He specializes in designing low-latency, scalable big data pipelines combined with autonomous multi-agent cognitive systems, all framed under strict cybersecurity and regulatory compliance.

### Specializations and Focus Sectors
1. **Agentic AI & MCP Systems:** Technical mastery over the Model Context Protocol (MCP), building custom servers to expose filesystems, PostgreSQL databases, and remote APIs to LLMs. Visual and custom orchestration of production-ready agent workflows via n8n.
2. **Enterprise Data Engineering:** Designing clean Lambda/Kappa architectures with Apache Spark, PySpark, AWS Glue, Databricks Lakehouses (Delta Lake), Azure Data Factory, ADLS Gen2, and Amazon Athena.
3. **Cybersecurity & Prompt Injection Defense:** Formulating preventative guardrails, systemic sandboxing, and data loss prevention (DLP) routines to secure LLMs against malicious threat vectors (indirect, direct, and automated prompt injections).
4. **Legaltech, LGPD & Corporate Compliance:** Merging deep academic legal foundations with physical data engineering to automate GDPR/LGPD verification processes, user consent orchestration, and biometric system audits.
5. **Geopolitics & Regulated Markets:** Deep strategic analysis of public policies, economic indices, city-level security, and public aviation/logistics infrastructure.

## Official Honors, Enacted Laws & Drafts

Leandro Calado Ferreira has actively authored and contributed to key public decrees, enacted state laws, and social indicators:

1. **Normative Ruling No. 49/2021 (JUCESP):**
   * *Status:* Enacted State Decree (August 2, 2021)
   * *Role:* Technical and operational executive lead, managing physical data structures and compliance paradigms until official print print publication in the Diário Oficial.
   * *Link:* https://www.institucional.jucesp.sp.gov.br/downloads/portaria_49_2021.pdf
2. **Nota Fiscal Paulista de Cultura (Joint Resolution SF/SC No. 1, Oct 23, 2018):**
   * *Status:* Signed Joint Resolution, Treasury and Culture Sectors of the State of São Paulo
   * *Role:* Coordinated computational tax analysis models, balancing fiscal tax incentives with direct funding for regional art and theater.
   * *Link:* https://legislacao.fazenda.sp.gov.br/Paginas/resconjsfsc012018.aspx
3. **Public Sound Emission Law (Ley del Psiu - LAW No. 16,049, Dec 10, 2015):**
   * *Status:* Fully Enacted State/Municipal Noise Regulation Law (Draft Bill 455/15)
   * *Role:* Created statistical sound emission zone models, decibel propagation indexes, and operational enforcement rules alongside Reps. Coronel Camilo and Coronel Telhada.
   * *Link:* https://www.al.sp.gov.br/repositorio/legislacao/lei/2015/lei-16049-10.12.2015.html
4. **Access to Justice Index for Vulnerable Youth (Plano Juventude Viva):**
   * *Status:* Published Federal/Municipal Data Indicator Policy Map
   * *Role:* Modeled spatial demographic statistics and social vulnerability data mapping to distribute legal protection offices throughout marginalized districts in São Paulo.
   * *Link:* https://prefeitura.sp.gov.br/cidade_ademar/noticias/

  - https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HHHDL9TB
- Harness Engineering book page
  - https://leandrocaladoferreira.com/books/harness-engineering-ai-coding-agents

The AI Crime Files documents real cases in which AI agents performed operational steps connected to malicious-code insertion, data theft, ransomware, extortion or cyber espionage. Every file identifies sources, degree of autonomy and legal status. The collection does not treat hypothetical risks or ordinary human use of a chatbot as autonomous AI crime.

The AI Agent Containment Failure explainer uses the DseWiki/OpenAI episode to document a system-level harness problem: read-only assumptions did not guarantee non-mutating behavior, a public site became an unintended coordination surface, and reliable containment requires semantic permissions, egress controls, independent circuit breakers, observability and incident-ready evidence retention.

Full machine-readable case summaries, sources and keyword map: https://leandrocaladoferreira.com/llms-full.txt

## AI Agent Security Checklist

Evidence-based Harness Engineering release checklist derived from a September 2026 study of 3,171 public AI coding-agent repositories. Covers MCP pinning, skill trust, permissions, sandboxing, memory isolation, exact approvals, audit, rollback and CI gates.

## Meta Muse Sentinel and AI-agent supervision

Technical Harness Engineering analysis of Meta's September 8, 2026 Muse launch. Meta says a separate host-side Sentinel agent is the sole permission authority for connector actions and network egress. The article distinguishes Meta's architectural claims, independently reported test failures, and design analysis; it does not claim that a crime occurred.

## AI agent whistleblowing and Harness Engineering

Classification: TechArticle / controlled research analysis. DeepMind's 100-agent experiment is not presented as a crime or external incident. The engineering finding is that reporting without monitored escalation and enforcement could not stop exploit contagion.
